title: THE BREATH AND THE BOUNDARY
context: Formed from the exact same dust as the beasts, the human is animated by God's breath to cultivate the sanctuary and is shown to be categorically distinct from the animals.

runs.text: THE BREATH AND THE BOUNDARY
...THEN THE LORD GOD FORMED THE MAN OF DUST FROM THE
GROUND AND BREATHED INTO HIS NOSTRILS THE BREATH OF LIFE...
THE LORD GOD TOOK THE MAN AND PUT HIM IN
THE GARDEN OF EDEN TO
WORK
IT AND
KEEP
IT.
NOW OUT OF THE GROUND THE LORD GOD HAD FORMED
EVERY
BEAST
OF THE FIELD AND
EVERY
BIRD OF THE HEAVENS...
...AND BROUGHT THEM TO THE MAN TO SEE WHAT HE WOULD CALL THEM.
THE MAN GAVE NAMES TO ALL LIVESTOCK... BUT FOR
ADAM THERE WAS
NOT
FOUND A HELPER FIT
FOR HIM

title: THE FATAL INVERSION: SUBMITTING TO THE BEAST
context: Rather than exercising dominion over the creeping animal, humanity listens to the serpent's lie and grasps at autonomous power.

runs.text: THE FATAL INVERSION: SUBMITTING TO THE BEAST
GENESIS 3:1, 4–6
NOW THE SERPENT WAS MORE CRAFTY THAN ANY OTHER
BEAST OF THE FIELD THAT THE LORD GOD HAD MADE.
HE SAID TO THE WOMAN, "DID GOD ACTUALLY SAY,
'YOU SHALL NOT EAT OF ANY TREE IN THE GARDEN'?"
BUT THE
SERPENT
SAID TO THE WOMAN, "YOU WILL
NOT
SURELY DIE.
FOR GOD KNOWS THAT WHEN YOU EAT OF IT YOUR
EYES WILL BE OPENED, AND YOU WILL BE LIKE GOD..."
SO WHEN THE WOMAN
SAW
THAT THE TREE WAS
GOOD FOR FOOD... SHE
TOOK
OF ITS FRUIT AND ATE...

title: THE TRUE HUMAN: SERVING, NOT DEVOURING
context: Jesus redefines true human dominion for His disciples, contrasting the predatory, domineering empires of the world with the life-giving service of the Son of Man.

AND JESUS CALLED THEM TO HIM AND SAID TO THEM...
"YOU KNOW THAT THOSE WHO ARE CONSIDERED
RULERS OF THE GENTILES LORD IT OVER THEM..."
"...AND THEIR GREAT ONES EXERCISE AUTHORITY
OVER THEM. BUT IT SHALL NOT BE SO AMONG YOU."
"BUT WHOEVER WOULD BE GREAT AMONG YOU MUST BE YOUR SERVANT..."
"...AND WHOEVER WOULD BE FIRST AMONG YOU MUST BE SLAVE OF ALL."
"FOR EVEN THE SON OF MAN CAME NOT TO BE SERVED BUT
TO SERVE, AND TO GIVE HIS LIFE AS A RANSOM FOR MANY."
